title: SC-12-05-03 Editing a card needs the current version
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a person card at version 3
When the manager edits it with version 2
Then the edit is rejected with PERSON_VERSION_CONFLICT
